mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) signals an easing monetary environment, which compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1350) and industrial production (INDPRO < 109.0) signals a contraction in both consumer demand and supply, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1350 and INDPRO < 109.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and rising > 0.1% in 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative 20-day returns due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% in 3 months
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% in 3 months, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 150,000) signals robust employment and consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 150,000, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1350) signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces expectations of future corporate revenue and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1350, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL > 258.0) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 1.5%) signals an aggressive monetary tightening response to inflation, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 258.0 and FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 109.0) signals a weakening supply chain and reduced manufacturing activity, which lowers corporate profit expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 109.0, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over the past 5 years.
